22 likes, 2 comments - jerusalemwallahtv on October 8, 2026: "Food is more than taste—it carries memories, traditions, and identity. ❤️🍽️

From mummy ke haath ka khana to nani ke haath ka khana, and the special dishes we associate with festivals, food keeps a piece of where we come from.

Israel’s food culture tells a similar story. 🇮🇱 Different communities brought their traditions, recipes, and ingredients from across the world. Over time, these influences adapted, blended, and evolved—creating a food culture that reflects the story of a people building a new home without leaving their roots behind.

Because sometimes, you don’t leave your culture behind. 
You add a new place to what you already carry. 🌍❤️

watch full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SbAOcflCQNA

#Israel #IsraeliFood #FoodAndCulture #CulturalHeritage #FoodStories #Traditions #Identity #IndiaIsrael".

396 likes, 75 comments - mumbaifoodjunkie on July 7, 2026: "Peri peri lovers, this one’s for you! 😍🔥

Burger King’s new Peri Peri Fest is one of the most exciting peri peri menus I’ve tried in a while. It’s not just spicy, it’s tangy, herby & perfectly seasoned 🤤

From the Whopper to the fries & chicken sides, every bite is packed with that bold peri peri kick. Pair it with a chilled Sprite, and you’ve got the perfect combo.💯

It’s available for a limited time, so if you’re a peri peri fan, this is a MUST TRY 🙌🏻

Now tell me—which are you picking first: the Whopper, Fries or Chicken Sides? 👀
